options.name: host
options.description: Select a protected host names entry (either a web host name or IP address).

options.name: host_status
options.description: Enable to apply this rule only to HTTP requests for specific web hosts. Disable to match the rule based on the URL and any parameter filter only.

options.name: name
options.description: name of the CSRF page rule

options.name: parameter_filter
options.description: Select to specify a parameter name and value to match. The parameter can be located in either the URL or the HTTP body of a request.

options.name: parameter_name
options.description: Enter the parameter name to match.

options.name: parameter_value
options.description: Enter either a literal URL or regular expression.

options.name: request_type
options.description: Select whether Full URL contains a literal URL (Simple String), or a regular expression designed to match multiple URLs (Regular Expression).

options.name: request_url
options.description: a literal URL or regular expression.
